text:
alex-ops: handing off night shift — quick summary:
- Regen surge in eu-west1 (incident #4532). p95 request latency climbed, some 502s from the regen router. routing fallback to smaller model variant enabled.
- Embed-ingest backlog: ~18k items, ingestion workers catching up but slower than usual.
- KV cache eviction rates spiking on kvproxy-2/3, causing extra upstream reads.
- Autoscaler churn visible early in the window, but stabilized after scale-up + conservative cooldown.

Mitigations done so far:
- Enabled routing fallback policy for eu-west1: fallback->redwood-small-v2 (works, ~60% lower memory).
- Manually scaled embed-ingest workers +2 replicas and increased job concurrency to 6.
- Adjusted kvproxy mem target on nodes (temp) to reduce eviction frequency.
- Posted alert to #incidents and triggered runbook steps.

Runbooks / useful links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/regen-surge (follow Fallback + Queue drain sections)
Embed queue dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/embeds/queue?cluster=eu-west1

Quick commands I ran:
```
# check embed-ingest pods
kubectl get pods -l app=embed-ingest -n prod-eu -o wide
# check kvproxy evictions
kubectl logs kvproxy-2 -n prod-eu | grep -i eviction | tail -n 50
```

Open action items / next steps (please pick up):
- jamal-eng: can you take lead on kvcache eviction root cause? look at allocator churn + recent kernel/kernel-opts changes. I left a minimal heap profile in /tmp/kv-heap-2026-03-17.txt.
- maria-ml: please validate the fallback small-model quality on the customer regression suite (prompt set: regen-fallback-check). If quality drops >5% flag it; we may need to enable partial routing only.
- sylvie-sre: please monitor the alert noise and decide on bridge if errors remain >5% for next 30m. I will notify support to slow non-urgent ingest jobs.

Notes / context:
- Customer-impact is limited to a subset of regen requests in eu-west1 (mainly long-context sessions). Hosted API customers in other regions unaffected.
- I saw a deploy of embeddings-worker v3.14 ~45m before surge — possible correlation, filing PR revert candidate if we see continued regressions.

Status updates since root:
maria-ml: thanks, taking fallback quality check now. ping me if you need me to pause more ingestion.
alex-ops: noted, I paused low-priority batch ingests (cron: embed-backfill) and left a comment in the cron job.
jamal-eng: on it — will start with heap profiles and pods' OOM logs, pinging in thread with findings.
sylvie-sre: watching alerts; if 5xx% > 5 for 15m I'll open bridge (will @here).
oncall-bot: Incident #4532 created and linked to thread (https://incidents.redwood/4532) :warning:

Handoff ending state:
- Mitigations in place and holding for now.
- Backlog draining but still ~18k.
- No bridge currently; escalation threshold set.

Signing off now — alex-ops out. If anything flares, @jamal-eng or @sylvie-sre, please escalate. :white_check_mark:
